remarks: Panoramic views, soaring ceilings, and a versatile five-bedroom layout distinguish this exceptional residence in the highly sought-after Stonegate community. Set on an expansive quarter-acre lot, 7550 Wiscasset Drive offers 2,752 square feet of living space, balancing formal gathering areas with comfortable everyday living. A dramatic spiral staircase, cathedral ceilings, and abundant natural light create a memorable entry. The main level features formal living and dining rooms, along with a spacious kitchen that opens to a family great room with soaring 20-foot ceilings.
